categories.main_business_segments: Gansu Golden Solar Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of high-efficiency heterojunction (HJT) solar cells and photovoltaic modules. The company also produces fireproof glass and steel door/window systems. Its core business focuses on N-type monocrystalline heterojunction solar cells and modules, serving the photovoltaic industry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced heterojunction with intrinsic thin layer (HJT) technology for solar cells, achieving conversion efficiencies up to 26%. Key production methods include large-size half-cut cells, 0BB (zero busbar) technology, silver-coated copper paste, screen printing, and advanced encapsulation techniques. The manufacturing process integrates silicon wafer thinning, silver paste optimization, and copper plating to reduce costs and improve efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are downstream photovoltaic module manufacturers and power plant operators, including domestic centralized and distributed solar power stations. Major clients include large domestic ground power stations and overseas customers in Singapore, India, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East. The company also serves construction and architectural sectors through its fireproof glass and steel systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Gansu and Jiangsu provinces. It has established overseas subsidiaries and sales offices in Europe (Germany, Netherlands, UK), Dubai, Hong Kong, and Macau to serve international markets. Domestic sales dominate, accounting for over 95% of revenue, with exports primarily to Germany and other emerging photovoltaic markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Gansu Golden Solar operates in the midstream segment of the photovoltaic supply chain, focusing on processing silicon wafers into solar cells and assembling cells into photovoltaic modules. It procures upstream raw materials like silicon and silver paste and sells finished cells and modules downstream to power plant developers and module assemblers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes cost reduction and efficiency improvement through R&D, focusing on heterojunction solar cell technology enhancements, including wafer thinning, silver paste optimization, 0BB technology, and advanced encapsulation. It has a dedicated R&D center and pursues innovation in materials and processes to accelerate large-scale industrialization of high-efficiency heterojunction cells.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of photovoltaic solar cells and modules. The company follows a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, targeting both domestic and international customers. Additional income streams include sales of fireproof glass products and rental income from investment properties.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the few capable of large-scale production of heterojunction solar cells in China, holding a competitive edge in technology and scale. It faces intense competition due to industry overcapacity and price declines but leverages its early investment in HJT technology and scale advantages to maintain market presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported a significant revenue decline of approximately 79% to 123.7 million RMB, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 795 million RMB, reflecting severe financial challenges and low capacity utilization. The company is undergoing pre-restructuring due to liquidity issues but expects operational improvement in 2025. Total assets stood at approximately 2.7 billion RMB with negative net equity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-efficiency heterojunction solar cells with superior conversion efficiency (up to 26%) and advanced module power output (up to 730W+). Its products offer advantages such as lower degradation, better temperature coefficients, and cost-effective manufacturing processes. The firm focuses on technological innovation and quality control to deliver high-performance, cost-competitive photovoltaic solutions.
